messages:
Ava (DevRel): Quick sync 5: planning a short community tutorial + tiny refapp + 30m webinar to show Redwood Dedicated dev flow. Need blog post, bench blurb, demo repo, webinar page, and inbound routing. Who can take what?

Noah (Content): I can draft the blog and three social cards. Need bench p50/p95 and a one-line TL;DR.

Maya (Growth): For routing: gated signup -> tag 'community-lab'; if >60k tokens in 7 days assign to AE, else nurture. Is 60k OK?

Ethan (PM): 60k sounds fine. Confirm we can publish test infra (A10G) and model used (redwood-small-v1). Add a short section on quantization tradeoffs.

Clara (Ops): I can create the registration page and schedule Wed 11am PT. Will need speaker names + bios and a 40min slot (10/20/10).

Ava (DevRel): I'll build the repo (Flask + Docker) and the demo script. Example run I'll include: `rdctl bench --model redwood-small-v1 --seq 256 --batch 4 --duration 180`. Pushing repo by Mon.

Noah (Content): Draft PR ready: github.com/redwood/content/pull/210 will add graphs when Ava uploads them. TL;DR candidate: "Run low-latency inference on Dedicated with a tiny refapp and clear cost tradeoffs."

Maya (Growth): I'll wire HubSpot mapping once the form is live and add UTM templates. Also will post a webhook to #sales-inbound for AE alerts.

Clara (Ops): Calendar event created: "Community Mini Lab 5 Wed 11am PT" https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3400000123

Ava (DevRel): Great 5 scheduling dry-run Tue 3pm PT. Thanks all!
